Practical dental care kit for dogs Looking for the right dental care for your dog? With our dental care set, consisting of a mint-flavoured toothpaste, a finger toothbrush, a finger massage brush and a double-sided toothbrush with two different heads, you can clean your dog's teeth optimally. With the large brush head for the front teeth and the small brush head for the molars, you can reach even hard-to-reach places. With the finger brush you can clean the more sensitive areas of your dog's mouth, as you can adjust the pressure very well with your finger. In addition, you can massage the gums of your furry friend with the brush, which aids a good blood circulation and prevents gum degeneration.
